paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates the effect of scaling up supervised fine-tuning (SFT) datasets on the CoLeG-R metric across different model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The horizontal axis contains three categorical groups representing model sizes: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B, arranged from left to right in order of increasing model scale. The vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0% to approximately 85%, with tick marks at intervals of 10%. Each model group contains four bars corresponding to different SFT conditions, as indicated by the legend: "no SFT" shown in blue with diagonal hatching, "+ SFT on D₀" shown in light orange/yellow with horizontal hatching, "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" shown in light purple with diagonal hatching, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" shown in light pink with a subtle pattern. For the LLaMA-2-7B group, the "no SFT" bar reaches approximately 67%, the "+ SFT on D₀" bar is also approximately 67%, the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" bar reaches approximately 81%, and the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" bar reaches approximately 83%. For the LLaMA-2-13B group, the "no SFT" bar is approximately 70%, "+ SFT on D₀" is approximately 74%, "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" is approximately 84%, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" is approximately 80%. For the LLaMA-2-70B group, the "no SFT" bar reaches approximately 81%, "+ SFT on D₀" is approximately 81%, "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" is approximately 84%, and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" is approximately 83%. Within each group, the four bars are placed side by side in the same order as listed in the legend from left to right. The bars are not sorted by value but rather by the SFT condition. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond their distinct color and hatching patterns, and the shortest bar across all groups is the "no SFT" bar for LLaMA-2-7B at approximately 67%, while the tallest bars are the "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" bars for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, both reaching approximately 84%.
